composition: The copied checker is identical to the checked native5 function bank. It enforces canonical proof-coordinate/public-scalar bounds, curve/subgroup conditions, actual public MSM, and the complete fixed-key four-pair equation.

The mandatory bridge copies the declared n0,n1 slots and the original 448-byte proof tuple. Legacy -Ay is mapped to Ay by canonical modular negation. The checker invocation is immediately followed by VERIFY.
The guard restores the original argument frame before the old program. Legacy auxiliary predicates impose further acceptance restrictions and receive no independent soundness credit.

For six profiles the immutable terminal root is transferred to the selected guarded genesis locking. The slim reference uses a bare terminal locking so its original reverse-offset frame remains unchanged. Externally anchored graph root and successful execution of the complete ordered input graph remain premises.

This establishes the coefficient identity; it does not recover the original individual alpha/beta declaration or independently prove their legacy role bindings. The original historical soundness withdrawal remains.
